item.title: Iolite can show three colors when viewed from different directions
item.description:
GEMOLOGY FACT: This directional color effect is called pleochroism.
EXIMUTC view: Compare the face-up and side views before judging a finished stone.
Source: www.gia.edu https://www.gia.edu/iolite
